description: A bed with a dark blue sheet and a pale pink pillow is in front, with a coiled white charging cable and a white smartphone near the lower edge. The right hand reaches to the cable, lifts the connector, and guides it into the phone’s port while the left hand holds and steadies the phone as a two-hand object; once connected, the left hand slides the phone a bit left and the right hand releases and rests near the loose cable.
